command:
import json,pathlib,csv,hashlib,decimal,datetime,re
p=pathlib.Path('.');m=json.loads((p/'docs/plans/boot-04-costs.json').read_text());sources=json.loads((p/'docs/plans/boot-04-sources.json').read_text());D=decimal.Decimal
rows=list(csv.DictReader((p/'docs/vision/requirements.csv').open()));groups=m['scope_coverage']
assert hashlib.sha256((p/m['scope_source']['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==m['scope_source']['sha256']
assert len(rows)==548 and len(groups)==33 and sum(r['source_optional']=='true' for r in rows)==20
assert sorted(r['requirement_id'] for r in rows)==sorted(i for g in groups for i in g['requirement_ids'])
for g in groups:
 rr=[r for r in rows if r['group_id']==g['group_id']]
 assert g['name']==rr[0]['group_name'] and g['requirement_ids']==[r['requirement_id'] for r in rr]
 assert g['optional_ids']==[r['requirement_id'] for r in rr if r['source_optional']=='true']
assert [g for g in groups if g['group_id']=='R33'][0]['requirement_ids']==[g for g in groups if g['group_id']=='R33'][0]['optional_ids']
assert m['director_inputs']['peak_concurrent_players']==50 and m['director_inputs']['provider_approval'] is None
c=m['capacity_assumptions'];assert c['peak_matches']==50/2 and c['aggregate_commands_per_second']==25*.1 and c['burst_commands_per_second']==12.5
assert c['accepted_commands_per_month']==25*.1*4*3600*30
assert D(str(c['projection_egress_decimal_GB']))==D(c['accepted_commands_per_month'])*D(12288)*3/D(10**9)
assert c['capacity_evidence'].startswith('not_run')
retrieval={x['id']:x for x in sources['retrievals']};checked=0
for r in retrieval.values():
 if r['sha256']:
  assert r['http_status']==200
  b=(p/'.local/boot-04-source-cache'/(r['id']+'.raw')).read_bytes()
  assert len(b)==r['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()==r['sha256'];checked+=1
  assert datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(r['finished_at'].replace('Z','+00:00'))>=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(r['started_at'].replace('Z','+00:00'))
assert retrieval['render-storage']['sha256'] is None and '404' in retrieval['render-storage']['error']
for key,r in m['rates'].items():
 assert r['source_id'] in retrieval and retrieval[r['source_id']]['http_status']==200
 assert r['usd']>=0 and r['unit'] and r['qualification']
 if r['source_id'] in ['aws-rds-region','aws-ecs-region','aws-elb-region','aws-vpc-region']:
  sku=re.search(r'SKU ([A-Z0-9]+)',r['selector']).group(1)
  j=json.loads((p/'.local/boot-04-source-cache'/(r['source_id']+'.raw')).read_bytes())
  assert j['products'][sku]['attributes']['regionCode']=='us-east-1'
  values=[D(x['pricePerUnit']['USD']) for term in j['terms']['OnDemand'][sku].values() for x in term['priceDimensions'].values()]
  assert D(str(r['usd'])) in values,(key,values)
raw=(p/'.local/boot-04-source-cache/sentry-pricing.raw').read_text();prices=[]
for body in re.findall(r'<script[^>]*type="application/ld\+json"[^>]*>(.*?)</script>',raw,re.S):
 data=json.loads(body)
 prices.extend(data.get('offers',{}).get('priceSpecification',[]))
assert [x for x in prices if x['name']=='Team Monthly Subscription'][0]['price']=='29'
for s in m['scenarios']:
 total=D(0)
 for line in s['lines']:
  actual=D(str(line['quantity']))*D(str(m['rates'][line['rate_id']]['usd']))
  if 'minimum_monthly_usd' in line:actual=max(actual,D(str(line['minimum_monthly_usd'])))
  assert actual==D(str(line['monthly_usd'])),line
  total+=actual
 assert total.quantize(D('.01'),rounding=decimal.ROUND_HALF_UP)==D(str(s['known_monthly_subtotal_usd']))
 assert not s['total_is_complete']
assert all(x['monthly_usd'] is None and x['reason'] for x in m['unpriced_items'])
report=(p/'docs/plans/2026-10-07-boot-04-provider-research.md').read_text()
for s in m['scenarios']:assert '$'+format(s['known_monthly_subtotal_usd'],'.2f') in report
assert (p/'docs/vision/requirements.csv').read_bytes()==__import__('subprocess').check_output(['git','show','5819142f76a1ea853b804af8b768048a3dccc4dd:docs/vision/requirements.csv'])
print('PASS scope:33 groups /548 unchanged leaf IDs /20 optional flags; R33 fully optional; X01-X07 preserved')
print('PASS cost:6 independently summed fixtures, cron minimums, explicit unknowns, unmeasured capacity and shared quota assumptions')
print('PASS sources:'+str(checked)+' actual public byte digests; unavailable404 excluded; AWS regional SKU prices and Sentry monthly29 matched')
print('LIMIT static research checks only; no deployed provider/load/failover/restore/device qualification; raw cache not committed')
summary: BOOT-04 static scope/quoted-rate arithmetic and retrieved-source digest checks; no runtime or capacity acceptance
